label: Supervision
summary: Supervision, in this context, refers to the oversight and guidance that requires genuine expertise to be meaningful. It is not just a procedural role but one that depends on the supervisor actually understanding what they are overseeing. The concept surfaces in discussions about how AI tools relate to learning and independent thinking.
open_questions: If someone uses AI to skip the hard work of building expertise, does their capacity to supervise AI outputs become compromised over time?
At what point does reliance on AI tools undermine the expertise that supervision requires?
